name: When should I consider adding an in-law suite to my home?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider adding an in-law suite to my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider adding an in-law suite if you anticipate needing dedicated living space for aging parents, adult children returning home, or regular long-term guests. It's also an excellent option if you're looking to generate passive rental income from your property or need a versatile space like a home office, gym, or art studio that requires full amenities and privacy. Furthermore, if you plan to stay in your current home long-term and desire to enhance its value and functionality, an ADU is a strategic investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider an in-law suite for family accommodation, rental income, a versatile private space, or to increase your property's long-term value and functionality.
